response.sql: SELECT m.MediaTypeId, AVG(t.UnitPrice) as avg_track_unit_price, AVG(t.UnitPrice) / (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track) as ratio FROM MediaType m LEFT JOIN Track t ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId ORDER BY AVG(t.UnitPrice) IS NULL, AVG(t.UnitPrice) / (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track) DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: "For each media type ID" includes all media types in the MediaType table, including those with zero tracks. Media types with no tracks produce NULL average prices and NULL ratios, which sort last. The phrase "any missing ratios last" suggests this interpretation.

alternatives.interpretation: "For each media type ID" refers only to media types that have at least one track in the Track table. This interpretation never produces NULL ratios.
